Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 57, 63, 65, 71, 73, 79, 145, 149
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

ahātu I

  • Meaning: pl. OA ahuātum, OB ahhātu "sister" [NIN] "(natural) sister"; transf. OA as complimentary term; OB of f. subst.s a. ... a. "the one ... the other";
  • Logograms: NIN
  • Lines: 3
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81tu%20I

ahāzu I

  • Meaning: "to take; marry; learn"
    • G: (a/u)
    • Gt: "be connected with; well versed in"
    • D: (OA infin. also ehhuzum) "mount, plate, inlay" with metal, stone (< ihzu denom.) [GAR(.RA)]; "marry" pl.
    • Dt: pass. of D
    • Štn: "instruct, inform s.o. repeatedly"; OB of disease "infect repeatedly"
    • Št1: OB "be instructed, incited"?
    • Št2: lex. "ignite" fire, "make" fire "catch"
    • N: pass. of G 2 "marry each other"; of fire etc. "catch, spread";
  • Logograms: GAR, GAR.RA
  • Lines: 118
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C4%81zu%20I

akalu I

  • Meaning: —
  • Logograms: NINDA, NINDA.HI.A, NINDA.MEŠ, NINDA
  • Lines: 105, 153
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/akalu%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 97, 105, 153
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 2
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 56, 64, 72, 145
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 91, 93, 102, 104, 106, 108, 110, 113, 115, 117, 132, 134, 144, 146, 148, 150, 152
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 4, 5, 11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 22, 31, 32, 36, 37, 41, 51, 55, 56, 57, 58, 59, 64, 65, 66, 67, 72, 73, 74, 75, 80, 84, 112, 133, 135, 145
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

anāku I

  • Meaning: "I; me" [Bogh. GÁ.E] as pred. freq. anākuma; OB ša anāku "as for me"; NB also acc. (to stress a pron. suff.), dat.
  • Logograms: GÁ.E
  • Lines: 8, 9, 95
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81ku%20I

apālu I

  • Meaning: "to pay; answer"
    • G: (a/u; NB pres. once ihappal ?)
    • Gtn: iter. "pay", "stand in for" on separate occasions
    • Gt: "answer one another, have discussion", "stand in for permanently"
    • D: "be held responsible"
    • Š: "make s.o. answer"
    • N: "be paid off, become satisfied"
  • Lines: 6, 10, 63, 71
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ap%C4%81lu%20I

ardu I

  • Meaning: "slave, servant" [ÌR(- ); IR11(- ); SAG.ÌR(- ); OA IR(- )];
  • Logograms: ÌR(- ), IR11(- ), SAG.ÌR(- ), IR(- )
  • Lines: 55
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ardu%20I

arāru III

  • Meaning: "to be convulsed" Bab.
    • G: (u/u, pres. also i'arru/ar) [UR4] of human beings, demons, animals, earth(quake) "tremble, shake", lit. "suffer cramp, be convulsed"?; med., of parts of body (freq. harāru, different word ?); of sea, rivers "be rough, muddy"
    • Gtn: iter.
    • D: ~ "stir up, frighten"; om., med. in stat. of parts of body "suffers cramp, convulses"
    • Dt: ~ "be stirred up, convulsed"
    • N: ingress. "begin to convulse"?
    • Ntn: iter. of N and G [UR4.UR4]
  • Logograms: UR4, UR4.UR4
  • Lines: 20, 37a, 40
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ar%C4%81ru%20III

ašābu I

ellu I

  • Meaning: "pure; clear" [KÙ; SIKIL] "pure, clean" of water, oil; "bright, shining" of metal, stone; of mountains, forests, onions; "(cultically, ritually) pure" of deity, person, hands; of incantation, symbol; temple, place; of meal, offering, wine; e. as subst., desig. of priest; Bogh., Ug. "free" as social class;
  • Logograms: KÙ, SIKIL

elû III

  • Meaning: "to go up, arise; (stat.) is high"
    • G: (i/i) [E11; jB also AN.TA]
    • Gtn: iter.
    • Gt: "go up and away"; of person, animal, silver, illness; O/jB ina X e. "forfeit X"
    • D: "make higher, raise" wall, building, 'head' (rēšu) of building; of deity "lift up, elevate" person, kingship (also with rēšu); "extol, praise (deity)"; NA "take away, remove"
    • Dtn: "repeatedly extol"
    • Š: [E11] caus. of G; jB ana zaqīpi š. "impale"; "post, install" garrison in fort etc.; Susa mê š. "have water close over one, be submerged" (in ordeal); "dedicate" to temple; "get out" from storage, kiln; "embark" person, goods; "bring forward" witnesses; "produce" lesion; "bring out, produce" tablet, lost property; "enter" on tablet; "introduce" bees to a region; "express" anxiety, thought; šum X š. "swear oath by X"; "disinherit" heir, "turn off, drive from" fields, land; "take" sheep from fold; "remove" boundary stone etc.; math. "subtract" [E11; NIM], "determine" root; Am. ša dama šūlû (desig. of gold)
    • Štn: iter. of Š
    • Št: jB of features in liver "be raised (as) high" as (= ana); Am. transf. of dowry "be made (as) immense as"

  • Meaning: "to seize, take; hold"
    • G: (a/a) [DAB]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] "continually engage in" prayers
    • Gt: (infin. etc. tiṣb...) [DAB(.DAB)] "hold one another", "wrestle", "be locked in combat", "engage in litigation"; of parts of body, liver etc. "be interlocked, grown together"; "hold fast" hand, emblem; stat. of ox
    • D: ~ G [DAB; DAB.DAB; DAB.MEŠ] also "enclose, bind, set" with metal (bands); "fasten" roofbeams, thread; "occupy" city; "block" road; "claim" protection (kidinnu)
    • Dtn: iter. "repeatedly take possession of"
    • Dt: pass. of D Am. "be captured"
    • Š: caus. of G [DAB] "direct" s.o.'s attention (pānū) towards (ana); "equip, provide with" income, pasturage, water; often ellipt. "put in place, install" door; "launch" ship; "post" guard; "install" gate-sculptures; "settle" inhabitants; "cause to catch" fire, "ignite"; "make s.o. (start to) do s.th."
    • Štn: pass. of Š NB of work "be started on"
    • Št2: "make o.s. take", OA "gather up" silver; OB "get" troops, animals, tools "ready"; "execute" plan, decision
    • N: pass. of G [DAB]; ~ Gt OA, OB "seize one another", "litigate"
    • Ntn: ~ Gt "be interlocked, grown together"; of teeth "lock each other"
